verses.original: אָ֭הַבְתִּי כִּֽי־ יִשְׁמַ֥ע׀ יְהוָ֑ה אֶת־ ק֝וֹלִ֗י תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
verses.literal: I love the LORD for He has heard my voice my appeal for mercy

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִטָּ֣ה אָזְנ֣וֹ לִ֑י וּבְיָמַ֥י אֶקְרָֽא׃
verses.literal: Because He has inclined His ear to me I will call on Him as long as I live

verses.original: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי׀ חֶבְלֵי־ מָ֗וֶת וּמְצָרֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל מְצָא֑וּנִי צָרָ֖ה וְיָג֣וֹן אֶמְצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·p̄ā·p̄ū·nî ḥeḇ·lê- mā·weṯ ū·mə·ṣā·rê šə·’ō·wl mə·ṣā·’ū·nî ṣā·rāh wə·yā·ḡō·wn ’em·ṣā
verses.literal: The ropes of death entangled me the anguish of Sheol overcame me I was confronted by trouble and sorrow

verses.original: וּבְשֵֽׁם־ יְהוָ֥ה אֶקְרָ֑א אָנָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַלְּטָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.literal: Then I called . . . on the name of the LORD O LORD deliver my soul
The LORD is gracious and righteous our God is full of compassion

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פְּתָאיִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה דַּ֝לּוֹתִ֗י וְלִ֣י יְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: šō·mêr pə·ṯā·yim Yah·weh dal·lō·w·ṯî wə·lî yə·hō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: The LORD preserves the simplehearted I was helpless and He saved me

verses.original: שׁוּבִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָ֑יְכִי כִּֽי־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה גָּמַ֥ל עָלָֽיְכִי׃
verses.transliteration: šū·ḇî nap̄·šî lim·nū·ḥā·yə·ḵî kî- Yah·weh gā·mal ‘ā·lā·yə·ḵî
verses.literal: Return to your rest O my soul . . . for the LORD has been good to you

verses.original: כִּ֤י חִלַּ֥צְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֗י מִ֫מָּ֥וֶת אֶת־ עֵינִ֥י מִן־ דִּמְעָ֑ה אֶת־ רַגְלִ֥י מִדֶּֽחִי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḥil·laṣ·tā nap̄·šî mim·mā·weṯ ’eṯ- ‘ê·nî min- dim·‘āh ’eṯ- raḡ·lî mid·de·ḥî
verses.literal: For You have delivered my soul from death my eyes from tears my feet from stumbling
I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living

verses.original: הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֲ֝נִ֗י עָנִ֥יתִי מְאֹֽד׃
verses.literal: I believed therefore I said I am greatly afflicted

verses.original: אֲ֭נִי אָמַ֣רְתִּי בְחָפְזִ֑י כָּֽל־ הָאָדָ֥ם כֹּזֵֽב׃
verses.literal: In my alarm I said All men are liars

verses.original: מָֽה־ אָשִׁ֥יב לַיהוָ֑ה כָּֽל־ תַּגְמוּל֥וֹהִי עָלָֽי׃
verses.literal: How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me

verses.original: כּוֹס־ יְשׁוּע֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֑א וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא׃
verses.literal: I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD

verses.original: נְ֭דָרַי לַיהוָ֣ה אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם נֶגְדָה־ נָּ֝֗א לְכָל־ עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of . . . all His people
Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints

verses.original: אָֽנָּ֣ה יְהוָה֮ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֪י עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲ‍ֽנִי־ עַ֭בְדְּךָ בֶּן־ אֲמָתֶ֑ךָ פִּ֝תַּ֗חְתָּ לְמוֹסֵרָֽי׃
verses.literal: Truly . . . O LORD I am Your servant I am Your servant the son of Your maidservant You have broken my bonds

verses.original: לְֽךָ־ אֶ֭זְבַּח זֶ֣בַח תּוֹדָ֑ה וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא׃
verses.literal: I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD

verses.original: נְ֭דָרַי לַיהוָ֣ה אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם נֶגְדָה־ נָּ֝֗א לְכָל־ עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence . . . of all His people

verses.original: בְּחַצְר֤וֹת׀ בֵּ֤ית יְהוָ֗ה בְּֽת֘וֹכֵ֤כִי יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥaṣ·rō·wṯ bêṯ Yah·weh bə·ṯō·w·ḵê·ḵî yə·rū·šā·lim hal·lū- yāh
verses.literal: in the courts of the LORD’s house in your midst O Jerusalem Hallelujah . . .
